question: According to the GSEs' August 2024 PMIERs update (Guidance 2024-01), what is the implementation phase-in schedule, and what substantive change does it make to the PMIERs standards?
expected_answer: The August 21, 2024 PMIERs update refined the Available Assets definition by introducing new investment-risk deductions based on asset class and credit rating (more granular bond credit-quality and liquidity tiers) and establishing new limits on assets backed by residential mortgages or commercial real estate. The phase-in is over 24 months: 25% effective March 31, 2025; 50% effective September 30, 2025; 75% effective March 31, 2026; and 100% effective September 30, 2026. Separately, the COVID-19 Disaster Related Capital Charge for COVID-19 Defaulted Loans was eliminated effective March 31, 2025.
agent_answer:
Guidance 2024-01 (issued August 21, 2024) amended PMIERs Section 703 (Available Assets and Minimum Required Assets), Section 802 (Reporting), and Exhibit D, and introduced Exhibit H.

**Substantive change:** It tightened the definition of eligible Available Assets — primarily bond eligibility and haircuts. Key changes:

- Bonds now must be rated by a prescribed rating agency (S&P, Moody's, Fitch, A.M. Best, DBRS, or KBRA); unrated bonds are ineligible.
- A new haircut table by credit rating (0.20% for AAA, climbing to 10.00% for BB+, 25.00% for B+, and 100% for CCC+ and below; U.S. government full-faith-and-credit securities at 0%).
- Explicit exclusions: mortgage-insurance-linked notes (MILNs), non-agency RMBS, BB-rated bonds with terms >5 years, B-rated bonds with terms >2 years, all bonds rated CCC+ or below, and non-agency CMBS below BBB-.
- New concentration limits: GSE debt/MBS ≤25% of Available Assets; ABS ≤20%; sub-investment-grade bonds plus common/preferred shares aggregate ≤5%; non-agency CMBS ≤5%; eligible surplus notes capped at 9% of Minimum Required Assets.
- The haircut on common and preferred shares was raised from 25% to 50%.

**Implementation phase-in schedule** (add-back from the prior framework / implied phase-in of the new rules):

| Quarter ending | Add-back (old framework) | Phase-in (new rules) |
|---|---|---|
| March 31, 2025 & June 30, 2025 | 75% | 25% |
| September 30, 2025 & December 31, 2025 | 50% | 50% |
| March 31, 2026 & June 30, 2026 | 25% | 75% |
| September 30, 2026 onward | 0% | 100% |

At the September 30, 2026 milestone, Guidance 2024-01 will be incorporated into the next published version of PMIERs.
rationale: Phase-in schedule and substantive changes to Available Assets definition with bond haircuts and concentration limits match expected answer.
